archetype: Archetype 3: Pastel & Soft (mutated into Gen-Z Neo-Brutalist Editorial)
emotional_tone: Raw, expressive, intellectual, culturally intelligent, intimate, atmospheric

typography.font_install_instructions: Add Cabinet Grotesk from Fontshare or local assets. Add Cormorant Garamond and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Neo-brutalist style. rounded-none or very subtle rounded-sm. 2px solid #111111 border. Hard drop shadow: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)].
surfaces_and_borders.buttons: Solid fill with 2px ink borders. On hover: translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] shadow-none.
surfaces_and_borders.header: Sticky glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F0EA]/80 border-b-2 border-[#111111].
surfaces_and_borders.inputs: Shadcn inputs heavily customized: rounded-none, border-2 border-[#111111], focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#FF1493].

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Asymmetrical grid layouts for Explore. Editorial reading widths (max-w-prose) for Lore pages.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use p-8 or p-12 for major section containers. Cards must have p-6.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Use 'bento' grid mode for Explore pages. Leave empty cells for negative space. Grid children must be direct elements.

components.connection_map: Use react-force-graph-2d or react-force-graph-3d. Nodes should use accent colors (Acid Green, Hyperpop Pink). Background transparent to blend with parchment base.
components.lore_entries: Editorial layout. Drop caps on first letter. Wide margins. Use Cormorant Garamond for body text, interspersed with large abstract pull-quotes in Cabinet Grotesk.
components.album_universe: Immersive page. For this section only, invert the theme to dark mode (base: #111111, text: #F4F0EA) to feel like 'stepping into' a different world.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Editorial Ribbon style: Slow drift, uppercase mono font, massive letter spacing.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hard brutalist physical button press (translate 2px down/right, remove shadow).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Snappy and immediate. No sluggish fades.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling to add a premium editorial feel.

media.notes: Image generation and stock APIs failed due to quota/provider limits. DO NOT use placeholder images. Instead, use pure CSS elements: deep noise gradients, large typographic lockups, and CSS-based grid lines to create visual interest. For album covers or artist shots, use CSS colored blocks (e.g., bg-[#FF1493] mixed with mix-blend-multiply) with heavy typography inside.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on parchment meets APCA guidelines. Ink (#111111) on Parchment (#F4F0EA) has excellent contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='explore-vibe-cluster-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required libraries: lenis (for smooth scroll), framer-motion, react-force-graph-2d, lucide-react.

Do NOT use standard Shadcn borders/shadows. Override all Shadcn components (cards, dialogs, inputs) to use rounded-none, 2px solid borders, and hard brutalist shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#111111]).
For the Connection Map interface, implement a functional node graph where clicking a node navigates to a Track, Album, or Lore page.
Do not build a typical audio player or feed. The UI must feel like a Wiki + Are.na + Editorial Magazine.
Since images could not be fetched, rely entirely on high-contrast typography, CSS noise textures (using SVG filters or CSS backgrounds), and sharp geometric shapes.
